description:
On the bed in front of you there’s an open gold book slipcase, with several small Tolkien paperbacks nearby (blue, green, and red covers).  
The left hand first reaches to the blue book on the right, lifts it, and slides it down into the open slipcase, then reaches for the green book, lifts and inserts it beside the blue one, and finally picks up the red book and pushes it into the remaining space while releasing each book after it’s seated; no right-hand object is used.
